resolves.IR-C2V4-01: REJECTED-AS-NON-BLOCKING — regraded BLOCKING on measured evidence

summary: The finding is upheld and REGRADED from MAJOR non-blocking to BLOCKING. The pre-freeze review established that _integer_guard_scan is evadable but concluded that no false accept is reachable on the frozen bytes. That conclusion is false, and it is false for the same reason the instrument is weak: the review's own widening and its 'exhaustive' sweep both retained the author's numeric model, in which a numeric operand must be an ast.Constant (the review widened it only to module-level names bound to numeric constants). Neither the instrument nor the audit of the instrument can see a comparison of a wire-sourced value against a COMPUTED integer. Three such comparisons exist in the frozen bytes, all three inside the scan's own declared 69-function reachable closure, and 48 wire-sourced integer positions are read through them. I drove them to a full green banner and exit 0 in BOTH normal and --selftest mode, with ZERO modification to check-c2-v4.py, using only the wire input the checker exists to validate. The minimal reproduction is a SINGLE character-level edit to the candidate contract. Under IMPLEMENTATION-FREEZE.md section 7 that is the evaluation-proof.v9 grading, not the grading of the seven.
whatIsNotBeingSaid: LB-C2-01 itself is genuinely and completely repaired at the wire-validator surface. I verified this by execution and it is not in dispute — see reachabilityVerdict.lbC201RepairConfirmed.
The seven pinned planIntentCommitment vectors are unmoved, under this checker and independently under the pinned v3 encoder check-c2.py.

This blocker is NOT against the exact-type guards. It is against the scan's advertised scope and against three unguarded admission sites the scan's own claim quantifies over. The repair must not touch the guard helpers.

The pre-freeze review's core defence-in-depth argument is correct FOR THE CLASS IT TESTED: every source-indirection evasion of the scan is caught by the behavioural census layer. I reproduced that result. It does not hold for this class, because here the behavioural layer IS the layer carrying the gap, and there is no third layer behind it.

decisionRuleApplied.source: IMPLEMENTATION-FREEZE.md section 7, 'Why evaluation-proof.v9 is graded differently from the seven above'
decisionRuleApplied.quotedVerbatim: The distinction is not severity of intent but whether the overstatement is *reachable*. The seven were graded non-blocking because a reviewer verified, at the AST level, that the frozen bytes contain no indirection for the gap to admit — the rule is true of those bytes even though the instrument establishing it is weaker than claimed. In v9 the gap was demonstrably reachable: an evasion satisfied the scan's own routing rule, kept its liveness counter ticking, and the checker printed `C-2 join RE-PINNED onto c2-plan-stage-schema.v4.json` while routing measured `{v3: 1, v4: 0}`. **The test is reachability on the actual bytes, not the category of the instrument.** A syntactic scan is not automatically advisory, and a residual graded advisory today becomes blocking the moment a successor introduces the indirection it cannot see.
decisionRuleApplied.questionAsPosed: On the frozen bytes of check-c2-v4.py, is there any admission path that reaches a comparison without passing a repaired exact-type guard?
decisionRuleApplied.answer: YES. Three comparison sites, 48 wire-sourced integer positions, inside the scan's own declared reachable closure, demonstrated to a green banner with no source modification.
decisionRuleApplied.whyThisIsTheV9GradingAndNotTheSevens: The seven were advisory because the gap's blind spot was EMPTY on the frozen bytes — an evasion had to be constructed by editing the source. Here the blind spot is OCCUPIED on the frozen bytes: the unguarded comparison is already written, already reached on every ordinary invocation, and the evasion requires editing only the input document. This is strictly stronger than evaluation-proof.v9, where the evasion still required mutating the checker.

theUnguardedSites.context: for key, value in measured["census"].items():  — `row` is bound at line 2479 from `declared.get(name)`, where `declared` is built from `c["hostileScalarLeafTotality"]["surfaces"]`, i.e. the UNPINNED candidate contract. `value` is a measured Python int.

whatTheFalseAcceptDoesAndDoesNotLaunder.doesLaunder: The publication-fidelity property — 'the published census equals the measured census'. That is precisely the property IMPLEMENTATION-FREEZE.md section 7 makes mandatory for every successor: 'Any successor publishing a totality or coverage claim must enumerate and inject at scalar leaf positions, not containers only, and must publish measured counts rather than a declared target.' The instrument that enforces it admits a JSON boolean or a JSON float in place of the JSON integer, at 48 positions.
whatTheFalseAcceptDoesAndDoesNotLaunder.doesNotLaunder: The substantive runtime property. Lines 2496-2511 fire named findings off measured['stats'] directly, independent of the published row, so a REAL nonzero escape or admission still produces a named LB-C2-01 / LB-C2-04 / C2V4-TOTALITY finding. I verified this: the selftest source-mutation battery still rejects all 68 retained cases under the false accept.
whatTheFalseAcceptDoesAndDoesNotLaunder.whyThatDoesNotRescueTheGrading: Section 7's test is reachability of the overstatement, not the blast radius of the payload. The seven advisory residuals were advisory because NO false accept was reachable, not because the reachable one was small. evaluation-proof.v9 was blocking on a green banner over a routing counter, which is likewise an instrument-fidelity property rather than a runtime one. Grading this advisory because the payload is a published integer rather than a runtime admission would be inventing a severity test that section 7 explicitly declines to use.

whatWouldMakeThisBlocking.conditionThatWasMet: IMPLEMENTATION-FREEZE.md section 7: an evasion that satisfies the scan's own rule while the checker prints a full green banner over a defective input. Met three independent ways (evasion attempts C, D and E), in both invocation modes, with check-c2-v4.py byte-identical to its frozen digest.
whatWouldMakeThisBlocking.theRaisingReviewsOwnFalsificationConditi: c2-plan-stage-schema.v4.review-independent-prefreeze.json, IR-C2V4-01.whatWouldChangeMyMind: 'If any of the eleven evading variants had produced a green run, or if my widened scan or exhaustive sweep had found even one unguarded wire comparison in the frozen bytes, this would be BLOCKING. Neither occurred.' Both occurred. My widened sweep found three unguarded wire comparisons in the frozen bytes at lines 2487, 2493 and 2517, and they produced a green run. The reviewer did not find them because their widened numeric model reached only 'module-level names bound to numeric constants' and their exhaustive sweep was defined as 'EVERY ast.Compare in the entire module for a numeric-LITERAL operand'. A comparison against a computed integer satisfies neither.
whatWouldHaveKeptItAdvisory: If the three sites had been guarded with is_wire_int the way lines 2196-2199 already are, the remaining finding would be the pure source-indirection class (evasion attempt A), which the behavioural layer catches 7 of 7 — that is NON-BLOCKING-REQUIRED-HARDENING, the EV10-IR-01 grading.
If every wire-sourced integer position had been unreachable or hash-pinned, as line 224's pinned-review comparison is.

If the census comparison had had an independent backstop. It does not: the census layer IS the behavioural backstop, so nothing stands behind it. This is the precise structural difference from evasion attempt A, and it is why the review's defence-in-depth reasoning does not transfer.
whatWouldMakeThisBlocking.explicitNonReason: This is NOT graded blocking because of the size of the payload, the plausibility of an author making the edit, or the aesthetics of the instrument. It is graded blocking on the single test section 7 specifies: the gap is reachable on the frozen bytes and it was reached.

mustNotDo: Do not weaken or alter the four exact-type guards or the seven GUARD_HELPERS. LB-C2-01 is repaired and the seven commitment vectors are pinned to those bytes.

Do not repair this by narrowing the claim alone. Option (a) of the pre-freeze review's requiredRepair — restating the docstring as 'refuses a bare numeric comparison in any top-level function reachable by direct name call' — would leave a live false accept in the shipped instrument while making the sentence true. That is not available here, because unlike EV10-IR-01 the gap is occupied.
mustDo: Route the three census comparisons through the existing type guard, exactly as lines 2196-2199 already do: require is_wire_int(row.get(key)) before comparing, at lines 2487, 2493 and 2517, covering all 48 wire integer positions.

Add hostileScalarLeafTotality.surfaces[*] and hostileScalarLeafTotality.contractRoot counters to c2-plan-stage-schema.v4.json planIntent.integerConstantFields.fields, which currently enumerates 8 fields and omits this entire block. The section's stated purpose is 'so a fifth site cannot be added silently'; this is that fifth site.

Widen _numeric_literal so a numeric operand is not required to be an ast.Constant: treat any operand that is not provably non-numeric as numeric, or invert the predicate to flag any wire operand in an Eq/NotEq/ordering comparison that does not pass a GUARD_HELPERS call. Narrowing to ast.Constant is what made this site invisible to the instrument AND to its independent reviewer.

Also adopt the pre-freeze review's option (b) widenings — function universe, callback edges, walrus/unpack/comprehension taint, named constants, In/NotIn — which that reviewer measured as costing nothing on these bytes.

Add retained SCAN_MUTATIONS for the computed-integer shape specifically, and a retained CONTRACT_MUTATION that spells a census counter as a JSON boolean and as a JSON float, so this exact false accept becomes a falsifiable retained case rather than a finding rediscovered by the next reviewer.
requiredRepair.successorRequired: Yes. Under IMPLEMENTATION-FREEZE.md section 7.2 the repair may not be made in place: it requires a version bump and a new independent verdict.

I did not evaluate the coverage, stage-plan, intent-binding or stored-view-binding wire surfaces with my own injection battery. I relied on the checker's own measured counts for those, cross-read against the pre-freeze review.

I did not audit the remaining 58 of the 61 Eq/NotEq wire-versus-non-literal sites individually beyond classifying their operand types; I confirmed by execution only that lines 2487/2493/2517 carry wire integers and that line 1215's nine descriptor fields carry no scalar integers.

I did not verify whether other retained checkers in this corpus (check-evidence-v10.py, check-evaluation-proof-v10.py, check-retention-custody-*.py) contain the same computed-integer comparison shape. Given that the narrowing is in the shared _numeric_literal idiom and that EV10-IR-01 is explicitly the same class, this is worth a sweep and I did not run it.
I did not execute check-completeness.py, and I did not evaluate what effect a BLOCKING disposition has on the seal-readiness count. That was deliberate: the count is not an input to this decision.
I am not authorised to and did not sign, seal, freeze or change any status. CD-RT-5 remains BLOCKED_ON_PHASE_1A. This document is an adjudication of one finding and nothing else.
